1-A037-USR.memo: 標的視点。捨てた武器の山ごと竜頭の波が正面から覆いかぶさる
1-A037-USR.brief: The viewer is the target. A wave of violet dragon-energy shaped into Jiend's horned head rears up on the left and breaks forward directly onto the camera, and the whole plain of discarded broken weapons is being torn up into it — the more wreckage it swallows, the heavier the crest becomes. Nothing stands between it and the viewer. Vertical composition. Focus: the jaws of the crest as they come down. Accent: molten gold along the crest against violet and a bone-white sky.

1-A038-USR.memo: 肩越しに見下ろす。黒い太陽から闇の輪が敵の隊列全体へ降り注ぐ
1-A038-USR.brief: From close behind and above Transard's shoulder — his spiked pauldron and one raised arm cropped along the bottom edge — looking down into a cathedral square where a black sun has opened low in the sky and is pouring a ring of violet fire downward across the entire enemy formation below, flattening ranks in every direction. Focus: the rim of the black sun where the fire leaves it. Accent: ember orange fires among violet-black smoke.

1-A039-USR.memo: 真横。斬撃が右から左へ走り、巨躯が線に沿って割れる。レオンは奥に小さく
1-A039-USR.brief: Strict side view. A single silver cut runs from the right edge to the left across the whole frame, and a towering armoured enemy is splitting along exactly that line, the upper half beginning to slide off the lower. Leon is far away and small at the right end of the cut, sword already fully extended after the stroke. Nothing else interrupts the line. Focus: the seam where the two halves separate. Accent: white-hot cut light and one scarlet cloak against a cold blue plain.

1-A040-USR.memo: 真上から。水没した床に横たわる仲間と、跪くハスミール。波紋が広がる
1-A040-USR.brief: Looking straight down from above onto shallow floodwater: a fallen knight lies on his back at the centre with Hasmir kneeling over him, both hands laid on his breastplate, her long dark-blue hair spread on the water. A column of light comes down around them and rings of light spread outward across the surface away from the camera. The knight's gauntlet has just opened. Vertical composition. Focus: the opening gauntlet. Accent: warm gold light on teal water. The fallen knight's chest is lifting with a first breath as the light reaches him.

1-A041-SR.memo: 地面から真上を見上げる。火炎竜巻の内側。燃える札が渦を上がっていく
1-A041-SR.brief: Camera lying on the ground at the foot of a fire tornado, looking straight up its throat: the spiral climbs away from the viewer into a small circle of sky, and burning cards torn from an enemy's deck are being carried up the wall of flame, curling and blackening as they rise. No caster is visible — only the inside of the vortex. Focus: the burning cards nearest the lens. Accent: white-gold core and scarlet flame against a distant teal sky.

1-A042-SR.memo: 隕石そのものが炎の竜。別個体の竜は出さない。人も出さない
1-A042-SR.brief: The meteor itself is the dragon: a falling mass of fire out of which a horned head, jaws and two clawed forelimbs have formed, diving nose-first into a dry lakebed with its wings of flame torn back along its body. Its shockwave ring is only now touching the cracked clay and the ground beneath is lifting. Nothing else is in the sky — no second dragon, no rider, no caster — and no human appears anywhere in the frame. Camera close to the lakebed and low, so the fire-dragon fills the upper frame coming down at the viewer. Focus: the forming jaws at the head of the fall. Accent: scarlet and gold fire against deep indigo night and pale cracked clay.

1-A043-SR.memo: 遠景の狙撃。矢そのものが飛んでいる。光線にしない
1-A043-SR.brief: A very wide valley at dusk. A single arrow — a real shaft with fletching, clearly a physical arrow — is caught in flight two thirds of the way across the frame, a thin trail of disturbed air behind it rather than any glowing beam, and beyond it a commander among his troops is taking it through his raised shield. The shooter is a small cropped silhouette at the top edge with a long-barrelled pistol still level. Focus: the arrow itself in mid-air. Accent: a scarlet fletching and the commander's scarlet banner against a pale blue valley.

1-A044-SR.memo: 壊れた柵越し。無数の槍が地面から噴き上がりこちらへ向かう
1-A044-SR.brief: Shot through the broken uprights of a palisade in the immediate foreground: beyond them a fan of hundreds of thin spears has erupted out of the marsh and is racing toward the camera, widening as it comes, water sheeting off the shafts. The lancer who started it is small at the left, spear butt still driven into the ground. Focus: the nearest spearheads as they pass the palisade. Accent: gold morning light on green water and steel.

1-A045-SR.memo: 敵の位置から見上げる。緑の雷樹が空から降りてきて全員を打つ
1-A045-SR.brief: Camera on the ground among the enemy, looking steeply up: a tree of acid-green lightning fills the whole sky and its branches are coming down onto the viewer and onto the soldiers around, their weapons dropping from numbed hands. The caster's boots and staff-butt are cropped along the bottom edge of the frame, far below the lightning. Focus: the branch reaching down at the camera. Accent: acid green against a violet storm sky.

1-A046-SR.memo: ディレイアを前面に。自分の傷→刃を伝う血→敵の胸当てを断つ、を一本の線で見せる
1-A046-SR.brief: Direia fills the left half of the frame in three-quarter view, close to the camera: her crimson vambrace is gashed open and dark blood runs from it down the back of her hand, along the grip and out onto the blade, where it soaks into the steel and burns red the whole length of the edge. That same edge has just finished its cut through an enemy's breastplate at the right, the plate opening along the line and the man folding away from it. The eye can follow one unbroken path: her wound, the blood, the glowing edge, the wound she made. Keep the blood to that path — no spray, no pooling, no splatter elsewhere. Focus: the blood meeting the burning edge on the blade. Accent: crimson against violet armour and a cool blue-grey street.

1-A047-SR.memo: 獣が敵術者の魔法陣を噛みちぎる。登場は獣と被害者の二者だけ
1-A047-SR.brief: A fanged, four-legged beast — fur, claws, no dragon anywhere — has lunged in from the right and clamped its jaws through a glowing sigil hanging in mid-air, and is hauling the light out of it in a long stretching strand that pours down its throat. Directly behind the sigil the enemy spellcaster who made it is thrown back on his heels, both hands still spread where the magic used to be, his sleeves and hair dragged toward the beast by the pull. There are exactly two figures in the picture — the beast and its victim — and no one else. Focus: the fangs biting through the sigil. Accent: sickly gold sigil light against violet-black fur and a cold blue cellar.

1-A048-SR.memo: クラウディアが二の太刀を振り抜いた姿勢。剣で斬った結果として十字が残る
1-A048-SR.brief: Claudia is caught at the end of the second of two cuts: her sword is fully extended out to her upper right with both hands still on the grip, hips and shoulders rotated all the way through, hair and cloak still travelling — she has just slashed, and the golden cross hanging in the air ahead of her lies exactly along the two paths her blade took. At the intersection a dark wraith is burning apart into smoke. She is in the left third, seen from behind and slightly below, inside the shadowed nave of a gutted cathedral. Focus: the blade at the end of the second stroke, with the cross reading back from it. Accent: gold light against deep blue stone.

1-A049-SR.memo: 真横。癒しの風が下から上へ吹き上がり、倒れていた兵が立つ
1-A049-SR.brief: Side view of a hillside. A warm wind rises from the ground upward through the whole frame, carrying white petals and streaks of light up past three soldiers: the lowest is still on one knee, the middle one is halfway up, the highest is already standing with his shield lifted. Hasmir stands in the right third with both arms raised, robes dragged upward. Focus: the middle soldier rising. Accent: honey gold and white against a teal sky. As the wind passes, the front-line soldier steps back out of the line and a fresh one moves up into his place.

1-A050-SR.memo: 低い斜めから。焚き火の脇で、札と物資を次々に背嚢へ詰め込んでいく
1-A050-SR.brief: Low three-quarter view across a night camp. Beside a small fire an open pack stands upright and is being stuffed full at speed: a pair of hands is pushing a fistful of cards down into it, more cards, flasks and bandages are stacked ready on the groundsheet, and the pack is already bulging with the flap unable to close. Firelight picks out the cards going in. Nobody is fighting; this is the moment of loading up before moving. Focus: the handful of cards entering the mouth of the pack. Accent: orange firelight on cream card backs against a deep blue-violet night.

1-A051-SR.memo: 真上から卓。古い札を卓の縁から払い落とし、新しい5枚が扇に着地する
1-A051-SR.brief: Directly overhead, tight on a war table. One hand sweeps the whole old hand of cards off the near edge of the table — five cards are tumbling away over the rim and out of the bottom of the frame, along with a scattered marker — while at the top of the table five fresh cards have just landed in a clean fan, still settling. The table surface between the two is bare wood. One lamp rakes across from the side. Focus: the fan of new cards as it settles. Accent: brass lamp gold and one red route line on cream card backs against deep violet shadow.

1-A052-SR.memo: 着弾のマクロ。敵の盾が無数の刺突で蜂の巣になる。オルスは下端で切れる
1-A052-SR.brief: Extreme close-up of an enemy shield being destroyed: a dozen puncture holes have opened across it in the same instant, the boards blowing outward toward the camera, the boss torn loose. Ors's single spear is still in the deepest hole and one of his fists is cropped along the bottom edge — one weapon only, no duplicated arms or afterimages. Focus: the cluster of holes at the centre. Accent: amber dust and a scarlet sash against blue steel. Spent cards are scattering away from the attacker's belt with the force of the flurry.

1-A053-R.memo: 遠景。竜巻が右から左へ平原を横断し、術者は奥に豆粒
1-A053-R.brief: A very wide plain under a shelved storm sky. A tornado crosses the frame from the right edge toward the left, dragging planks, roof tiles and a scarlet banner up its spiral, and the enemy line beneath it is scattering. The caster is a tiny figure far away in the depth of the frame with one arm still sweeping across. Focus: the scarlet banner circling in the funnel. Accent: a scarlet banner and an amber rip in the sky against a blue-green storm.

1-A054-R.memo: 吊るした鍋越し。竈の奥から炎の精が立ち上がる
1-A054-R.brief: Shot past hanging pots and a chain in the immediate foreground, into the depth of a ruined kitchen: at the centre a fire spirit is climbing up out of the hearth, its shape still forming, sparks streaming back into the hearth mouth behind it. Parkle stands beyond the fire with a ladle raised, lit orange from below. Focus: the spirit's forming head. Accent: ember orange against blue-green tiles and warm brass. The spirit is forming up out of a single burning card lying in the embers.

1-A055-R.memo: 凍った地面すれすれから見上げる。ダダを中心に氷が放射状に走る
1-A055-R.brief: Camera almost on the frozen mud, looking up: Dada-da-da's stone fist is planted on the ground at the centre and a front of ice is racing outward from it in every direction across the battlefield, sealing boot prints and locking two enemies' feet into the ground at the edges of the frame. Lightning still crawls in the golem's seams. Focus: the fist and the first crystals leaving it. Accent: cyan ice and amber seams against ochre mud.

1-A056-R.memo: 斜め俯瞰。峡谷の右手前に竜、ブレスが奥へ這って上壁を舐める
1-A056-R.brief: High three-quarter view down into a gorge. A great dragon occupies the near right of the frame, head lowered, and its breath rolls away from it into the depth of the canyon and up the far wall, washing over a scattered line of soldiers on the floor below who are throwing their shields up. No human casts anything. Focus: the jaws where the breath is born. Accent: amber and scarlet fire against blue-violet rock.

1-A057-R.memo: 標的視点。左から右へ振り抜かれた戦鎚が顔面直前まで来ている
1-A057-R.brief: The viewer is the target. A warhammer head, swung from the left, is a hand's breadth from the camera and still travelling right, the air ahead of it already compressing into a ring of dust. The wielder's shoulders and arms are cropped along the top edge, the rest of him out of frame. Behind the hammer the sky tilts with the blow. Focus: the hammer face nearest the lens. Accent: amber dust and a gold rivet against cool blue-grey stone.

1-A058-R.memo: 敵兵の肩越し。青い電気の面が石畳を走ってこちらへ来る
1-A058-R.brief: From just behind an enemy soldier's shoulder — his helmet and back cropped at the right edge — a flat sheet of blue electricity is racing up the wet street toward him and the camera, jumping between the iron lampposts as it comes, throwing his shadow back at the lens. The caster is a small silhouette at the far end of the street. Focus: the leading edge of the sheet. Accent: electric cyan against warm lamplight and black wet stone.

1-A059-R.memo: 盾列を断つ大斬撃。刃と切断面を見せる。光線にしない
1-A059-R.brief: Strict side view of a braced shield wall. A two-handed steel sword — solid, dull-edged, unmistakably a blade — has swept down through three shields at once and is still buried in the third, and the boards are opening along the line the steel took, rims and splinters blowing outward, the men behind them thrown apart. There is no beam and no bar of light: the damage is a physical cut, with only a thin white glint along the moving edge. The swordsman is cropped at the bottom edge. Focus: the middle shield as it parts around the blade. Accent: scarlet shield devices against grey steel and a cold blue sky.

1-A060-R.memo: 真上から。谷全体が溶岩の裂け目で割れる。踏んだ者は奥に小さく
1-A060-R.brief: Looking straight down on a valley floor from high above. A radiating star of lava fissures splits the whole valley from a single point, molten seams running out to every edge of the frame, slabs of ground tilting and enemy soldiers scattered like grains along the cracks. The armoured figure who stamped is small and far off at the centre of the star, both hands empty, no weapon anywhere. Focus: the white-hot centre. Accent: molten orange against black rock.

1-A061-R.memo: 地面から見上げる。砂の錐が中央から奥へ尾根を貫く
1-A061-R.brief: Camera low on the desert floor looking up: Dosso's green slime bulk rises at the centre of the frame and a drill of compressed sand is boring away from it into the depth of the shot, straight through a ridge, blowing a fan of grit out of the far side where two soldiers are knocked flat. Focus: the mouth of the bore where the sand turns to spray. Accent: warm ochre sand and green slime against a pale teal sky.

1-A062-R.memo: 着弾のマクロ。掲げた敵の剣に白金の雷が落ち、放射状に砕ける
1-A062-R.brief: Extreme close-up on the point where a bolt of white-gold lightning strikes an enemy's raised sword: the blade is exploding into fragments that fly outward in every direction, the gauntlet holding it opening. Claudia is small and low in the corner of the frame with her own sword raised in both hands, having called it. Focus: the shattering blade. Accent: white-gold light and a scarlet cloak against a bruised violet sky.

1-A063-R.memo: 遠景。両軍の間で拳大の球が相殺し、蒸気の柱が立ち上がる
1-A063-R.brief: Wide shot of the ground between two facing lines. In the gap a fist-sized sphere of fire and frost is annihilating itself, and a column of steam and ice needles is climbing straight up out of it into the sky, bending both lines away. Bodan stands in the right third, one red arm and one blue arm still spread apart from releasing it. Focus: the base of the steam column. Accent: hot orange and ice cyan against a cool grey field.

1-A064-R.memo: 墓標の槍越し。地に刺さった槍が次々抜け、左から右へ向きを変える
1-A064-R.brief: Shot between two grave-marker spears standing in the immediate foreground. Beyond them a whole field of planted spears is tearing itself out of the earth in a wave running from left to right, soil still dropping from the shafts, the nearest ones already levelled at the enemy. Sobert's bowed head and black sleeve are cropped at the top edge. Focus: the spear breaking free in the middle of the wave. Accent: pale gold light on ochre earth against teal fog.

1-A065-R.memo: 選ばれた標的の視点。城壁上の射手を見上げ、矢がこちらへ来る
1-A065-R.brief: The viewer is the chosen target, on the ground looking steeply up at a curtain wall: an archer leans out over the parapet at the upper left, bow arm still extended, and the arrow she loosed is already halfway down toward the camera, filling the centre of the frame point-first. Everything else is empty cold sky. Focus: the arrowhead nearest the lens. Accent: a scarlet fletching against a pale blue winter sky and grey stone.

1-A066-R.memo: 斜め俯瞰。氷の城が生え、敵の斧が壁で砕けて下へ落ちる
1-A066-R.brief: High three-quarter view over a frozen lake. A fortress of ice has erupted from the surface and is still assembling, and an enemy's axe has shattered against its wall — the head and splinters are dropping away down the ice face toward the bottom of the frame while the man who swung it staggers. The caster's raised hand is cropped at the bottom edge. Focus: the point where the axe broke. Accent: cyan and white ice lit gold, violet shadows on the lake.

1-A067-R.memo: 敵列の視点。雷が右から左へ次々に落ちてくる。アイは奥に小さく
1-A067-R.brief: Camera down among the enemy ranks looking out: a thunderhead has condensed overhead and bolts are striking down the line one after another from the right of the frame toward the left, men dropping their weapons as each hits. Ai is a tiny distant figure on a rock at the far right with both hands raised. Focus: the nearest bolt landing among the shields. Accent: white-violet lightning against slate cloud and an amber horizon.

1-A068-R.memo: レオンの肩越し。燃える弧が奥へ走り、門を裂いて敵を焼く
1-A068-R.brief: From close behind Leon's shoulder, his red hair and scorched pauldron cropped at the left of frame and his sword arm extended away from the camera: the burning arc he has just made runs away from the viewer into the depth of the courtyard, splitting an iron-banded gate at the far end and engulfing the raider in front of it. Focus: the far end of the arc where the gate opens. Accent: white-gold and scarlet fire against deep blue stone.

1-A069-R.memo: 真横。空中に残った霜の傷から、氷が放射状に広がり雨が止まる
1-A069-R.brief: Strict side view. A wound of frost hangs in the empty air at the centre of the frame where a blade passed, and ice is blooming outward from it in every direction, freezing the falling rain in place in a widening sphere and catching an enemy mid-stride with one boot locked off the ground. The swordsman is entirely out of frame. Focus: the centre of the frost wound. Accent: cyan-white ice and one scarlet cloak against a deep blue night.

1-A070-R.memo: 真上から。白い一条が盾の列を素通りし、盾は無傷のまま
1-A070-R.brief: Looking straight down from above onto a locked shield wall. A single narrow beam of pure white light crosses the frame and passes straight through three overlapping shields without marking them — the shields stay whole and flat — and strikes the man lying behind them. The beam is clean and unhurried, no smoke, no scorching. Focus: where the beam crosses the middle shield. Accent: white-gold light against cool blue shields and warm ochre ground.

1-A071-R.memo: 地面から見上げる。金光の巨大な鎚が左から右へ振り下ろされる
1-A071-R.brief: Camera flat on a cracked marble floor looking steeply up. A vast hammer made of golden light swings down from the upper left toward the right and is about to land, filling the top half of the frame; the cracks in the marble are already racing out beneath it toward the lens. The paladin who called it is cropped at the top edge, staff raised. Focus: the head of the light hammer. Accent: gold light against cool blue marble and a crimson carpet.

1-A072-R.memo: 着弾のマクロ。柱の裏に隠れた兵の背に、曲がった影の矢が刺さる
1-A072-R.brief: Extreme close-up on the back of an enemy sheltering behind a pillar: a bolt of shadow has curved around the stone and is punching into his backplate toward the camera, the metal dishing inward, violet vapour peeling off the shaft. The curve of its flight is visible behind it, bending around the pillar edge at the left. Focus: the bolt entering the backplate. Accent: magenta-violet against warm gold dust light and grey stone.

1-A073-R.memo: 遠景。装備が敵の身体から下へ剥がれ落ちる。槍兵は小さい
1-A073-R.brief: Mid-wide view of a plaza. An enemy has been struck at one precise point and his gear is coming off him downward — shield falling from a snapped strap, sword belt parting, a vambrace spinning to the ground at his feet — while the man himself is untouched and off balance. The lancer who did it is small at the far side of the plaza, spear still extended. Focus: the shield falling away from the arm. Accent: warm leather straps and a gold buckle against cool grey flagstones.

1-A074-R.memo: 垂れた蔓越し。奥の兵の腕が右から左へ樹皮に変わり、傷が塞がる
1-A074-R.brief: Shot through hanging vines in the immediate foreground. Deeper in the frame a soldier stands with one arm held out, and bark is spreading along it from right to left, turning the limb into living branch and leaf, roots dropping from the fingers into the soil — and an open gash on that arm is closing over as the bark reaches it. Focus: the wound sealing under the new bark. Accent: emerald leaf and warm gold sunlight against violet forest shade.

1-A075-R.memo: 見上げる。頭上に浮く黒い立方体が、矢も炎も表面で飲み込む
1-A075-R.brief: Camera low, looking up: a matte-black cube hangs overhead in the centre of the frame, and arrows and a gout of flame arriving from behind the viewer are vanishing at its underside without leaving a mark, their tips simply ceasing to exist. The caster stands beyond and below it, unhurt, one hand still raised. Focus: the cube's lower edge where the flame is swallowed. Accent: magenta light bleeding along the cube's edges against amber flame.

1-A076-R.memo: 斜め俯瞰。矢が幹の間を縫って奥へ走り、通過ごとに葉が放射状に散る
1-A076-R.brief: High three-quarter view down through a forest canopy. An arrow's path threads away between crowded trunks into the depth of the wood, and at every trunk it passes, leaves burst outward in a small radial spray, marking the line all the way to an enemy turning too late at the far end. Foggia is small at the near edge, bow still forward, having shot from the rear rank. Focus: the arrow at mid-flight. Accent: gold sunbeams and emerald leaf against blue-green shadow.

1-A077-R.memo: 犠牲者の視点。三本の紅い糸が自分の胸から上へ、右のアニマへ吸われる
1-A077-R.brief: The viewer is the victim. Exactly three threads of red light are being pulled up out of the camera's own chest and drawn upward to the right, where Anima crouches at the frame's right edge with one open three-clawed limb extended, the threads disappearing into its jaws. The snow between drains of colour as they pass. Focus: the three threads leaving the viewer's chest. Accent: blood-red threads against blue-violet snow. A gash along Anima's own flank is visibly knitting shut as the threads arrive.

1-A078-R.memo: 肩越し。虚空の円錐が左から右へ走り、膝をついた敵を吹き飛ばす
1-A078-R.brief: From behind the attacker's shoulder — cropped along the top edge, only the black gauntlet and forearm entering the frame — the punch travels left to right and the air along its line has collapsed into a cone of void that is lifting a kneeling enemy off the ground and folding him backwards over it. Focus: the knuckles at the point of contact. Accent: magenta-violet void light against warm amber dust.

1-A079-R.memo: 真横。盾の膜が野営を覆い、雨が膜の上で砕けて手前へ流れる
1-A079-R.brief: Strict side view from outside a camp in the rain. A dome of overlapping translucent shield-planes covers the whole encampment, and the downpour is breaking apart against its outer surface and running off it toward the camera in sheets. Inside, soldiers keep working dry around a lamp. The knight holding it up stands in the left third, shield raised overhead. Nobody is fighting. Focus: the rain shattering on the dome's near face. Accent: warm gold lamplight inside against cold teal rain. The knight's boots are set wide and half-sunk in the mud — he is rooted there and not moving until it lifts.

1-A080-R.memo: 真上から。帯電した刃が下へ振り抜かれ、水たまりへ電気が飛ぶ
1-A080-R.brief: Looking straight down onto a rain-soaked yard. An electrified blade has cut downward through an enemy's raised guard, and arcs are leaping off it into every puddle around them, each one flaring white where it earths. Claudia is cropped along the bottom edge — gold pauldron, ponytail, and the top of the sword arm. Focus: the blade where it meets the guard. Accent: white-blue arcs against warm lamplight on black wet stone.

1-A081-R.memo: 地面から見上げる。右から左へ、腕が竜の前肢に変わっていく
1-A081-R.brief: Camera on the ground looking steeply up at a soldier against the sky: his raised arm crosses the frame from right to left and is changing along its length — human skin splitting into overlapping dragon scales, the hand lengthening into a clawed foreleg, gold light burning between each new scale. Nothing is held in that hand. Focus: the boundary where skin becomes scale. Accent: magenta-gold scale light against a deep blue evening sky.

1-A082-R.memo: 掌のマクロ。紫の呪印が焼き付き、煙が奥へ流れる
1-A082-R.brief: Extreme close-up on an upturned palm filling the frame: a ring of violet script is burning itself into the skin, the smoke streaming away from the camera into the dark behind, the fingers shaking and a line of blood running back along the wrist. The cost is being paid in the same instant as the power arrives. Focus: the burning script at the centre of the palm. Accent: magenta-violet fire against warm candle amber.

1-A083-R.memo: 遠景。剣士はもう画面にいない。敵の胸当てだけが放射状に裂ける
1-A083-R.brief: Wide shot of an empty morning courtyard. An enemy stands alone in the middle of the frame and his breastplate is opening along one clean diagonal, the split running out to the edges of the plate, his knees just starting to give. The swordsman is nowhere in the picture — only a line of disturbed dust leading out of frame shows where he passed. No blood, the helm stays closed. Focus: the opening cut. Accent: one silver-white line and a scarlet cloak on the ground against pale stone.

1-A084-R.memo: 葉越し。花の蔓が下から上へ跳ね、闇の影が光で弾ける
1-A084-R.brief: Shot through foliage in the foreground. A whip of flowering vine cracks upward from the lower frame toward the top right, and where its tip reaches a shadow-creature clinging to a ruined orchard wall, the darkness is bursting apart into petals of light. Foggia stands in the right third, arm still following the crack. Focus: the tip at the moment of contact. Accent: white-gold blossom light and emerald vine against violet shadow.

1-A085-R.memo: 見上げる。掲げた刃の刃筋を、光が左から右へ走っていく
1-A085-R.brief: Camera low, looking up at a plain iron sword held overhead against an open sky. A keen line of light is running along its edge from the hilt at the left of the frame toward the point at the right, sharpening as it travels, the air beside it starting to distort. The hands and forearms holding it are cropped at the top edge; nothing has happened yet. Focus: the leading end of the light. Accent: cyan-white edge light against a warm amber dawn sky.

1-A086-UC.memo: 斜め俯瞰。光の輪が手前へ広がり、通ったところの兵が起き上がる
1-A086-UC.brief: High three-quarter view over a stone terrace. A circle of white-gold light is spreading outward toward the camera across the flagstones, driving frost back as it goes, and a wounded soldier it has already reached is pushing himself up onto one elbow while another further out is still down. The healer stands in the left third with both palms lowered. Focus: the rising soldier's hand on the stone. Accent: warm gold light against teal frost and blue-grey stone.

1-A087-UC.memo: 正面。革の口枷が千切れて手前下へ落ち、獣の息が上がる
1-A087-UC.brief: Facing the beast head-on. A cracked leather muzzle-strap has snapped and is falling toward the bottom of the frame past the camera, the buckle still turning in the air, while behind it the beast's jaw opens and breath steams up into the cold. Its body stays a dark mass; only the broken strap is sharp. Focus: the torn end of the strap. Accent: a burning gold eye and crimson leather against cold blue twilight.

1-A088-UC.memo: 肩越し。走りながら盾で受け流し、奥の補給箱から札を掴む
1-A088-UC.brief: From just behind a soldier's shoulder as he moves at a crouching run: a blow skids off the rim of his small round shield from right to left in a shower of sparks without slowing him, and ahead of him in the depth of the frame his other hand is closing on a card from an open supply crate he is passing. Both feet are off-balance in stride. Focus: the shield rim where the blow skids. Accent: a red painted rim and gold sparks against cool grey dust.

1-A089-UC.memo: 真横。射手列が一斉に放ち、矢の群れが奥の敵陣へ登っていく
1-A089-UC.brief: Strict side view. A rank of archers occupies the near left of the frame, all of them at the instant of release — bow arms forward, strings blurred, fingers snapped open — and the volley climbs away from them into the depth of the shot toward a mass of enemies on the far ridge, the leading arrows already falling among them. Focus: the nearest archer's open hand and string. Accent: scarlet fletchings against a pale gold sky and green field.

1-A090-UC.memo: 真上から。大槌が盾に当たり、砂塵が放射状に広がる
1-A090-UC.brief: Looking straight down. A maul head has landed square on an enemy's shield and the shield is splitting under it, a ring of dust blasting outward in every direction across the ground from the point of contact. Only the wielder's two hands and the head of the weapon are in frame; the rest of him is out of shot above. Focus: the shield splitting under the head. Accent: warm amber dust and a gold shield rim against cool blue-grey ground.

1-A091-UC.memo: 地面から見上げる。盾ごと突っ込み、柵の板が上へ跳ね上がる
1-A091-UC.brief: Camera at ground level on the far side of a barricade, looking up. A shieldbearer has driven into it shield-first from the right and the planks are bowing and flying upward and outward over the lens, the defenders behind them thrown back off their feet. Focus: the shield rim against the breaking plank. Accent: heraldic blue and gold on the shield against ochre wood and a cool sky.

1-A092-UC.memo: マクロ。左から右への突風で、敵の手から盾がもぎ取られる
1-A092-UC.brief: Close on an enemy's forearm and grip: a gust travelling left to right has torn his shield out of his hand, the leather strap snapping and the shield already a hand's width clear and tumbling away, his fingers still open in the shape of the grip. Long wind streaks cross the frame in the same direction. The caster's sweeping arm is cropped at the top edge. Focus: the snapping strap. Accent: teal-white wind and a scarlet glove against gold-green grass.

1-A093-UC.memo: 回転する槍が正面から迫り、盾を螺旋に穿つ
1-A093-UC.brief: The lance comes almost straight at the camera, one clean shaft with one steel head, spinning as it drives forward, and the compressed air wraps it in a tight visible corkscrew of dust that is boring through an enemy's shield in the near foreground and bursting out the far side. The weapon reads clearly against an open background with nothing overlapping it. Focus: the spearhead entering the shield. Accent: a gold dust spiral against cool blue steel.

1-A094-UC.memo: 崩れた石壁越し。竜気の顎が上から下へ噛み下ろす
1-A094-UC.brief: Shot through a gap in broken masonry in the foreground. Beyond it, jaws of condensed draconic energy — a translucent dragon's head of red-orange light — are closing downward on an enemy from above, the bite's shockwave blowing a ring of ash outward beneath them and buckling his shield inward. No human caster appears. Focus: where the upper and lower jaws meet. Accent: magenta-red energy against grey-teal ash.

1-A095-UC.memo: 見上げる。獣が右から左へ頭上を疾走し、三本の爪痕を引いていく
1-A095-UC.brief: Camera low, looking up. A beast tears across overhead from right to left at full speed, its body already half out of the left edge and blurred with motion, dragging three long parallel claw trails through a hanging banner and an enemy's raised shield in one continuous line. Long horizontal speed streaks fill the air behind it. Focus: the middle of the three trails where the shield opens. Accent: crimson claw trails and a gold banner against deep brown shadow.

1-A096-UC.memo: 斜め俯瞰。星光の矢が夜空に穴を開け、そこから敵の札が4枚落ちる
1-A096-UC.brief: High three-quarter view of a night landscape. An arrow of starlight has punched a ragged hole through the constellations overhead, and out of that hole exactly four cards are tumbling down through the sky, burning at the edges as they fall toward the enemy camp below. Foggia stands small at the centre of the ground, bow still raised. Focus: the torn hole and the four falling cards. Accent: gold leaking light against a deep teal-blue night.

1-A097-UC.memo: 標的視点。燃える斬撃が正面から届き、火の粉が放射状に飛ぶ
1-A097-UC.brief: The viewer is the target. A burning cut arrives across the camera's own guard, the blade already through the raised bracer in front of the lens, embers blasting outward in every direction from the line of the cut and rolling smoke filling the frame behind it. Leon is out of frame; only the burning arc and the ruined bracer are visible. Focus: the glowing edge of the cut. Accent: ember orange and white-gold against a violet night.

1-A098-UC.memo: 肩越し。石突きの炎で右上へ射出され、槍を先頭に突っ込む
1-A098-UC.brief: From behind and below the lancer's shoulder as she is launched: a jet of flame roars out of the butt of her spear at the lower left and drives her up and away toward the upper right, body stretched flat behind the levelled point, dust blown back in a cone past the camera. The enemy she is aimed at is bracing far ahead. Focus: the flame jet at the spear butt. Accent: orange jet flame against a cool blue sky. She has launched from the rear rank: her own front line is still parting below and behind her.

1-A099-UC.memo: 真横。落ち葉が左から右へ流れ込み、両掌の間で球になる
1-A099-UC.brief: Strict side view. Dry autumn leaves and dust stream in from the left edge of the frame and spiral together into a clear sphere of visible wind held between two open hands at the right, the grass on the hillside bending inward along the same line. The hands and forearms are cropped at the top edge; no face. Focus: the tight core of the sphere. Accent: amber leaves and warm gold light against a teal-white swirl. A single card is spinning in the orbit of leaves, drawn out of her belt pouch by the gathering wind.

1-A100-UC.memo: 真上から。石畳を割って食樹が生え、根が手前へ伸びて瓦礫を引き込む
1-A100-UC.brief: Looking straight down. A carnivorous tree has burst up through paving stones, slabs tipping outward around its trunk, and its bloom is closing over an enemy's dropped axe at the centre while its roots crawl toward the camera dragging scattered debris back with them. The caster's palm is flat on the stone at the left edge. Focus: the bloom closing on the axe. Accent: magenta flower throat and emerald leaf against wet blue-grey stone. Loose cards are being drawn up off the ground and swallowed into the bloom along with the debris.

1-A101-UC.memo: 地面から見上げる。家より大きい土の板が上から落ちてくる
1-A101-UC.brief: Camera flat on the battlefield looking straight up. An enormous slab of raised earth, far bigger than a house, fills the top of the frame and is coming down toward the lens, soil and stones already raining off its underside, its shadow swallowing the ground. An enemy at the edge of the frame is scrambling clear too slowly. Focus: the leading edge of the slab. Accent: warm ochre earth against a pale teal sky.

1-A102-UC.memo: マクロ。開いた補給箱から中身が右から左へこぼれ出す
1-A102-UC.brief: Extreme close-up on the mouth of a kicked-open supply crate: bandages unrolling, flasks rolling and arrow bundles sliding out of it from right to left across a groundsheet, the lid still swinging at the top of the frame. Everything is caught mid-spill. Focus: the unrolling bandage nearest the lens. Accent: warm gold light and a scarlet cloth bundle against pale canvas. A fan of cards spills out among the bandages and flasks.

1-A103-UC.memo: 遠景。鉄杭の列が手前から奥へ次々突き上がり、敵列を貫いていく
1-A103-UC.brief: Wide shot along an enemy line. A line of iron spikes is erupting out of the ground one after another, running away from the camera into the depth of the frame, each one taking the man above it off his feet, electricity crawling up their lengths and jumping between them. The nearest spike is closest to the lens and the furthest is only now breaking the surface. Focus: the nearest spike tearing out of the soil. Accent: cyan arcs and rust-orange iron against wet brown ground.

1-A104-UC.memo: 味方側から。しゃがむ兵の間越しに、壁の向こう面へ矢が突き刺さって止まる
1-A104-UC.brief: The camera is on the protected side of the wall, low, shot between two crouching soldiers whose backs and shields frame the foreground. In front of them a wall of packed earth and stone has erupted, soil still spilling off its crest, and the arrows fired from the enemy beyond have buried themselves in its far face — their points have punched partway through the near face and stopped dead, jutting a finger's width out of the earth above the crouching men. Every arrow in the picture is embedded and motionless in the earth — none of them is in flight on this side, and none has passed through. Nothing has reached the defenders. Focus: the arrow points stopped in the earth. Accent: warm ochre earth and one scarlet fletching against a cool teal sky.

1-A105-UC.memo: 見上げる。光の拳が上の胸当てに刺さり、羽根が上へ舞い上がる
1-A105-UC.brief: Camera low, looking up at an enemy from below. A gauntleted fist wrapped in white light has landed square in his breastplate above the lens, the plate caving in around the knuckles, and a burst of radiant feathers is scattering upward from the point of contact into the sky. The attacker's arm enters from the right of frame. Focus: the knuckles against the caving plate. Accent: white-gold light and pale rose feathers against cool blue armour.

1-A106-UC.memo: 斜め俯瞰。戦場を光が左から右へ渡り、通ったところの味方が立ち直る
1-A106-UC.brief: High three-quarter view over churned battlefield ground in the middle of a fight. A wave of warm light sweeps across it from left to right: the soldier it has already passed is straightening up with a gash on his shoulder closing, the one it is reaching now is lifting a dropped shield, and the one further right is still bent over. The singer's head and shoulders are cropped at the top edge. Focus: the boundary where the light is arriving. Accent: warm gold against cool blue-grey shadow.

1-A107-UC.memo: 卓の向こう側から。三枚の札がこちらへ押し出される
1-A107-UC.brief: The camera sits on the far side of a map table in a night tent, level with its surface. Three route cards are being pushed across the map toward the lens, one still under a fingertip, and two officers lean in over them from the other side with their heads cropped by the top edge. One oil lamp at the left blows the map out to near-white and throws the rest of the tent into deep shadow. Focus: the nearest card as it slides. Accent: brass lamp gold and one red route line against violet-brown shadow.

1-A108-UC.memo: 肩越し。霜が下へ降り、敵の札入れを凍らせて閉じてしまう
1-A108-UC.brief: From behind the caster's shoulder, her pale hand cropped at the top of the frame with fingers still spread: frost is travelling downward from it across the gap and closing over an enemy's card pouch at his belt, the flap sealing under a sheet of ice and fern patterns spreading across the leather. He is grabbing at it too late. Focus: the frozen flap of the pouch. Accent: palest cyan frost against warm brown leather.

1-A109-UC.memo: 真横。葉から落ちる雨が右から左へ流れ、両陣営の器に溜まっていく
1-A109-UC.brief: Side view of a jungle slope. Broad leaves tip in sequence from the right of the frame to the left, pouring a sudden warm rain down through the canopy, and on both sides of the slope small groups of soldiers hold out helmets and cupped hands to catch it. Both sides are gaining from it. Focus: the lip of the nearest leaf where the water breaks free. Accent: saturated emerald leaf and gold light against cool blue shade. Two cards ride down on the falling water into each pair of waiting hands.

1-A110-UC.memo: 真上から。ブリキのカップのアイスと、その脇に一枚の札
1-A110-UC.brief: Looking straight down onto a battered wooden table. A chipped tin cup of pale ice cream sits at the centre with frost on its rim and one bright drip running down the side, a spoon laid beside it and a single card tucked half under the saucer. The grain of the table runs away from the camera into shadow. No people. Focus: the melting edge where the drip leaves the rim. Accent: mint green and warm amber wood against cool blue shade.

1-A111-UC.memo: 地面から見上げる。号令の腕が上にあり、兵が放射状に走り出す
1-A111-UC.brief: Camera flat on the ground in the middle of a formation, looking up. A commander's arm is thrust forward overhead across the top of the frame, cropped at the shoulder, and around and past the lens soldiers are breaking into a run outward in every direction, boots slamming down beside the camera, one drawn card still in the commander's other hand. Focus: the signalling arm against the sky. Accent: a scarlet banner and gold light against cool grey dust.

1-A112-C.memo: マクロ。組んだ手の間から光が上へ立ち上り、味方の肩に降りる
1-A112-C.brief: Extreme close-up on a pair of clasped hands in the right of the frame. A thread of warm light rises upward out of the gap between the thumbs and opens above them, and three small motes of that light drift up and away to settle on the shoulders of allies who are only soft shapes in the background. Focus: the gap between the thumbs where the light is born. Accent: warm gold light against violet shadow and worn brown leather.

1-A113-C.memo: やや引き。掌の炎が左から右へ走り、敵の腰の札が二枚燃えて散る
1-A113-C.brief: A flat burst of flame crosses the frame from an open palm at the left to an enemy's raised guard at the right, washing over his bracer — and exactly two cards are torn from the sheaf at his belt by the blast, already curling and burning as they blow away behind him. The caster is small at the left edge, cropped by a wall. Focus: the two burning cards leaving his belt. Accent: orange flame and paper cream against a deep teal interior.

1-A114-C.memo: 枯れ葦越し。冷気が手前へ這い、敵の足が地面ごと凍って止まる
1-A114-C.brief: Shot through dry reeds in the immediate foreground. A rolling wave of white cold comes toward the camera across flooded ground from a caster at the left, and where it has already passed, an enemy's boots are locked into the frozen puddle he was standing in, ice climbing his greaves as he pulls uselessly against it. Both the caster's hands are empty. Focus: the boot locked into the ice. Accent: pale cyan ice against warm ochre mud.

1-A115-C.memo: 見上げる。雷が上から降り、敵の腕が下へだらりと落ちる
1-A115-C.brief: Camera low, looking up at an enemy from below. A blue jolt has come down from above into his shoulder plate and is crawling over the metal, and the arm below it is dropping open, his weapon slipping out of the loosening fingers toward the bottom of the frame. His face stays out of shot. Focus: the fingers as the grip fails. Accent: cyan arcs against warm brown leather and a bruised violet sky.

1-A116-C.memo: 斜め俯瞰。拳一つが盾を撃ち抜き、木片が放射状に飛ぶ。腕は一本だけ
1-A116-C.brief: High three-quarter view down onto the moment of contact. A single bare fist has punched into a round wooden shield and gone through it, the boards blasting apart in a radial burst of splinters, the defender's arm folding back past his ribs. Exactly one arm belonging to the attacker is visible in the frame — one shoulder, one forearm, one fist — and no second limb, weapon or afterimage appears anywhere. Focus: the knuckles buried in the broken boards. Accent: warm amber wood and a gold shield rim against cool blue steel.

1-A117-C.memo: 弾の真後ろから。闇の弾が奥へ飛び、敵の肩当てに突き刺さる
1-A117-C.brief: The camera sits just behind and above a bolt of dark energy as it flies, so the bolt recedes away from the lens down the centre of the frame with a violet ring of warped air around it, and at the far end it punches into an enemy's shoulder plate, blowing dark motes out behind him. The caster is entirely out of frame behind the camera. Focus: the bolt at the moment it lands. Accent: magenta-violet against warm brown leather and cool grey steel.

1-A118-C.memo: 竜の顎越し。炎が放射状に洞窟へ広がり、複数の敵を巻き込む
1-A118-C.brief: Shot from just behind a young dragon's head — its horns and lower jaw cropped along the top and bottom edges of the frame — as it looses fire: the sheet of flame spreads outward from the jaws in a wide radial fan across a cavern, catching three separate soldiers at once at different distances and throwing all of them back. Focus: the throat where the fire leaves. Accent: orange fire against blue-teal stone.

1-A119-C.memo: 真横。氷の翼で滑空して槍を刺し、敵が上へ跳ね上がる
1-A119-C.brief: Strict side view. A winged soldier has come in low along the frame on ice-crusted wings and driven a levelled spear into an enemy's midsection, and the impact is lifting the man off his feet and upward toward the top right of the frame, his own weapon flying loose above him. Frost trails off the wingtips behind. Focus: the spear point where it lands. Accent: white-cyan frost and a scarlet cloak against a cold pale sky.

1-A120-C.memo: 真上から。落ちた盾に二つ目の穴。刃はまだ刺さったまま
1-A120-C.brief: Looking straight down at a shield lying flat on the ground where its owner dropped it. Two thin puncture holes stand a hand apart across it, running left to right — the older one clean, the newer one still with the spear point in it and splinters lifting around the steel. The lancer's arm is cropped at the top edge, fully extended. Focus: the fresh hole with the blade in it. Accent: a gold spark and warm oak against cool blue steel.

1-A121-C.memo: 地面から見上げる。根が敵の脚を登り、色が手前へ流れ落ちる
1-A121-C.brief: Camera flat in the mud looking up along an enemy's leg. Fine roots have wrapped his greave and are climbing, and everything they have touched has drained to pale grey, while the stolen colour runs back down the roots toward the camera and out of the bottom of the frame. He is trying to lift the foot and cannot. Focus: the roots gripping the ankle. Accent: saturated emerald roots against drained grey leather and warm mud. At the bottom edge, the cut on the caster's own hand is closing as the colour reaches it.

1-A122-C.memo: 盾面のマクロ。矢が折れて破片が下へ落ちる。盾は微動だにしない
1-A122-C.brief: Extreme close-up on the face of a tall kite shield, filling the frame. Arrows are breaking apart against it — shafts snapping in half, heads flattening, splinters and fletchings dropping away down the front of the shield toward the bottom edge — while the shield itself does not move at all. The bearer's gauntlet is cropped at the bottom, knuckles white on the grip. Focus: the arrow snapping at the boss. Accent: heraldic blue and gold with scarlet fletchings against warm sunlit dust.

1-A123-C.memo: 受け流し。敵の刃が突っ込んでくるのを、こちらの刃が横から滑らせて外す
1-A123-C.brief: Mid-shot of two duellists in a stone hall. The enemy on the left has lunged in with his own sword fully extended toward the defender's chest — his blade is clearly the one attacking — and the defender on the right has laid her blade across it at a shallow angle and is sliding it away: the attacking sword is skidding off to the side, its point now passing wide of her shoulder into empty air, and the lunging man's balance is going with it. One spark at the contact. Neither blade glows. Focus: the point where the two edges ride against each other. Accent: one warm gold spark against cool blue steel and a deep violet hall.

1-A124-C.memo: 柱の間越し。円の受け流しで、敵の槍が奥へ逸れていく
1-A124-C.brief: Shot through the gap between two stone pillars in the foreground. Beyond them a circular parry has thrown an enemy's spear wide: the ring of the sweep hangs in the air as a clean circle of light and the spear is riding off along its outside, travelling away from the camera into the depth of the hall with its owner stumbling after it. Focus: where the spear leaves the ring. Accent: a gold ring of light against deep blue shadow.

1-A125-C.memo: 見上げる。人より大きなオウーが体当たりし、兜が吹き飛んで頭が露わになる
1-A125-C.brief: Ou — an enormous flightless bird far larger than a man — comes down out of the sky and slams into a soldier's head, and is already pulling up and away; the impact tears the helm clean off so that it spins away through the air and the soldier's head is left bare, hair flying, his body folding sideways under the weight. Loose feathers hang along the line of the strike. Camera low and close on the soldier, looking steeply up so Ou's bulk fills the top of the frame. Focus: the bare head and the helm spinning off it. Accent: a scarlet crest and warm underwing against a pale gold morning sky.

1-A126-C.memo: 斜め俯瞰。セヴンが上から踵を落とし、砂塵が上へ吹き上がる
1-A126-C.brief: High three-quarter view looking down. Seven has dropped out of the air onto an enemy's raised shield heel-first, one dragon wing still spread above him for balance, and the shield is dishing inward under the boot while dust and grit blast upward past the camera. The man beneath is buckling at the knees. Focus: the heel against the shield face. Accent: a yellow scarf and warm ochre dust against cool blue-grey ground. He has come from the rear rank — his own front line is still parting beneath him.

1-A127-C.memo: 投げられた側の視点。地面が迫り、掴んでいた手が上で離れる
1-A127-C.brief: The viewer is the man being thrown. The churned ground is rushing up at the camera from the left, filth and water already spraying, and above the frame a fist is just opening as it releases its grip on a torn collar, the thrower's shoulders cropped along the top edge. The horizon is tipped nearly vertical with the motion. Focus: the releasing fist above. Accent: warm ochre filth and a scarlet cloak against cool grey rain.

1-A128-C.memo: 敵の肩越し。斬撃が盾を割ってこちらへ抜けてくる
1-A128-C.brief: From behind an enemy's shoulder, his backplate and the inside of his shield arm cropped along the right of the frame: a cut has come straight through the shield he was holding and is emerging on this side, the two halves of the board separating toward the camera and the arm strap parting. Nothing stopped it. Focus: the cut edge of the shield as it opens. Accent: a silver-white cut line and a scarlet device against warm oak.

1-A129-C.memo: 真横。柵板の隙間から下向きに槍が突き込まれ、板が割れる
1-A129-C.brief: Strict side view of a plank fence. A spear has been driven downward through the gap between two boards and is emerging on the far side, splitting the lower plank along its grain and throwing splinters down, with the enemy on that side twisting away from the point too late. The attacker stays entirely hidden behind the fence. Focus: the split in the plank around the shaft. Accent: warm weathered wood and one strip of gold daylight against cool grey shadow.

1-A130-C.memo: 真上から。包帯の染みが右から左へ薄れ、傷が塞がっていく
1-A130-C.brief: Looking straight down onto a bandaged forearm lying on a folded cloak. A palm-sized light is held just above it and the dark stain on the linen is fading away from right to left as the light passes over, the fingers of the wounded hand unclenching at the left end of the frame. The healer's hand is cropped at the top edge. Focus: the retreating edge of the stain. Accent: warm gold light and linen cream against cool blue shadow.

1-A131-C.memo: 地面から見上げる。火床から引き上げた穂先が赤熱し、火の粉が奥へ上る
1-A131-C.brief: Camera low beside a brazier looking up. A spearhead has just been lifted out of the coals at the centre of the frame, glowing white at the edge and orange along the socket, and its sparks stream upward and away from the lens into the dark of the smithy. The tongs and one bare forearm hold it steady. Focus: the hottest part of the blade. Accent: ember orange and warm gold against a deep blue-black interior.

1-A132-C.memo: 着弾のマクロ。若木が盾を叩き、根と土が放射状に飛ぶ
1-A132-C.brief: Extreme close-up on the moment an uprooted young tree lands across an enemy's shield: the trunk is bending with the impact, the shield boards are caving, and roots, soil clods and leaves are blasting outward in every direction from the point of contact past the camera. Bikou's bare forearm and white sleeve are cropped at the left edge. Focus: where the trunk meets the shield. Accent: emerald leaf and warm brown soil against cool grey steel.

1-A133-C.memo: やや引き。二人が全速ですれ違い、片方が下がり片方が前に出る。記号は描かせない
1-A133-C.brief: Mid-wide view of the bare ground between two facing battle lines, with only two soldiers in it. They are passing each other at a dead sprint: the one leaving the front is side-on moving right, shield dropped to his hip, head turned back over his shoulder; the one taking his place is moving left, driving forward with his shield rising, close enough that their cloaks tangle as they cross. Loose dust kicks up behind each of them from their boots. No third figure, no caster, and nothing drawn in the air. Focus: the two shoulders as they pass. Accent: one scarlet surcoat against a cool blue-grey field.

1-A134-C.memo: 割れた窓枠越し。投げ斧が左から右へ飛び、電網に絡んで止まる
1-A134-C.brief: Shot through a broken window frame in the foreground. Beyond it a thrown axe travelling left to right has hit a net of thin electric lines strung between two poles: the lines are bowing back around the head, sparking hard where they touch, and the axe has stopped dead in the air and is beginning to drop. Focus: the axe head tangled in the bowed lines. Accent: cyan lines and warm orange sparks against a deep blue-black night.

1-A135-C.memo: 控えから前線へ割り込み、盾を地面に突き立てて動かなくなる。本人が主役
1-A135-C.brief: Camera low on the ground in the front line, looking up at a heavy shieldbearer as he arrives. He has just come forward out of the rear rank — his own comrades are still parting behind him and the lighter soldier he is replacing is slipping back past his shoulder — and he is driving the bottom edge of his tall shield down into the earth in front of him, boots planted wide and braced, soil heaping around the shield's foot. He has stopped dead and is plainly not moving again: shoulder locked behind the shield, weight settled, blocking the whole lane between the two lines. Arrows from the enemy beyond are already striking the shield's face. Focus: the base of the shield being rammed into the ground. Accent: heraldic blue and gold on the shield with scarlet fletchings, against cool grey dust.

1-A136-C.memo: 風で渓谷から吹き上がる。夜明けの霧、緑のマント。屋根も兜の列も出さない
1-A136-C.brief: Dawn over a deep, mist-filled ravine. A soldier in a green cloak is blasted straight up out of the fog by a jet of compressed wind under her boots, already clear of the ravine lip and rising into open sky, the mist torn into a spreading ring below her where the gust broke it. One hand is pulling fresh cards from her belt pouch as she climbs. No rooftops, no ranks of soldiers, nobody else in the frame. Camera from across the ravine at her own height. Focus: the ring of torn mist beneath her boots. Accent: a green cloak and warm dawn gold against cool grey-blue fog.

1-A137-C.memo: 敵側から見る。味方の頭上を右から左へ跳び越えて前に出る。武器は抜かない
1-A137-C.brief: Seen from in front of the friendly line, from the enemy's side. A soldier sails through the air above his own front rank from the right of the frame toward the left, body stretched forward into the leap, cloak snapping straight out behind, both feet well clear of the helmets beneath him. His sword stays in its scabbard — nothing is attacked and no blow is thrown. The men he passes over are turning to watch him go. Focus: the daylight gap between his boots and the helmets. Accent: a scarlet cloak against a pale bright sky.

1-A138-C.memo: 肩越し。放った矢が奥へ小さくなっていく。弦はまだ震えている
1-A138-C.brief: From just behind and above a shooter's shoulder, looking down the line of the shot: the bow and open fingers are close at the bottom of the frame with the string still blurred, and the arrow is already well away, receding into the depth of the picture toward a distant figure. Focus: the vibrating string. Accent: a scarlet fletching and warm bow-wood against a cool grey-blue distance.

1-A139-C.memo: 真横。石垣に広げた兵の食事。人は出さない
1-A139-C.brief: Strict side view along a low stone wall used as a table. A soldier's meal is unwrapped on a folded cloth: dark bread, a wedge of cheese, an apple cut open, a chipped tin cup with steam still coming off it, and a single card propped against the cup. Nobody is in frame. Focus: the cut face of the apple. Accent: a bright red apple and warm gold light against cool blue-grey stone.

1-A140-C.memo: 真上から。地面に置かれた盾に矢が一本立ち、影が右へ伸びる
1-A140-C.brief: Looking straight down. A round shield lies canted against the ground where it was snapped up in time, and one arrow stands buried in its painted face, the shaft still quivering, its shadow thrown out to the right across the dirt. The bearer's forearm and strap are cropped at the right edge, still braced. Focus: the arrow where it entered the boards. Accent: faded heraldic blue and a scarlet fletching against warm oak and grey dust.

1-A141-C.memo: 城門の影から陽光へ飛び出す。逆光、白い上衣。空を背にしない
1-A141-C.brief: Inside the dark archway of a castle gate, looking out. A soldier in a white surcoat launches off the flagstones and out through the arch into hard midday sunlight, fully airborne with both feet clear, arms tucked, the blaze of the courtyard beyond blowing out to bare white paper around her. She is almost a silhouette against it, and the shadowed gatehouse stonework frames her on all sides. No sky, no helmet ranks, no red cloak. Focus: the boundary where she crosses from shadow into the light. Accent: white-gold light against deep violet-brown stone.

1-A142-C.memo: 着弾のマクロ。獣の三本爪が盾を抉る瞬間。木片が手前へ飛ぶ
1-A142-C.brief: Macro on the face of a wooden shield at the instant a beast's three long claws rake across it: the claws are still buried in the wood, exactly three deep gouges opening behind them, and a burst of splinters and painted chips is exploding outward toward the viewer along the line of the rake, with torn air streaking behind the claws. A restrained violet shimmer clings to the claws and to the freshest edge of each gouge. Focus: the leading claw where the wood is still tearing. Accent: a crimson painted device and warm pale wood against cool green forest light.

1-A143-C.memo: 遠景。斜面を駆け下って逃げる兵。追手は上に残される
1-A143-C.brief: Wide shot down a hillside. A soldier is sprinting away from the camera down the slope at full stretch, one arm flung back, a fistful of cards clutched in the other, his cloak streaming; behind and above him on the ridge his pursuers are only just cresting, too far back to catch him. He is small but unmistakably the subject. Focus: his trailing hand and the cards in it. Accent: a scarlet cloak against a cool green slope and grey sky.

1-A144-C.memo: 夜戦。松明の列の上を飛び越える。真下から見上げ、下から照らされる
1-A144-C.brief: Night battle, camera flat on the ground looking straight up. A soldier in a dark cloak passes overhead from right to left, lit orange from below by a line of torches held by the men he is flying over — he clears the first torchbearer entirely and is coming down beyond the second, who is already stepping aside. The torch flames stream sideways in his wake. Black sky above, no daylight anywhere. Focus: the torchbearer directly beneath the flying boots. Accent: torch orange against a black night sky.
